teaser: Midnight, and the light under the door is still on, a page half-marked, a thought half-finished. You are a 9 walking a path built around letting go, carrying the four letters of the INTP, a mind built to take things apart before setting them down. A wish to hand the world something whole keeps meeting a need to be certain before anything gets handed over at all. That gap is the particular weight of this reading: a compassion that reasons itself into delay, a generosity that keeps auditing its own motives before it gives.
